instruction.text: Read the chapter, then answer the questions.

atoms.text: The leader of the Spanning Society was a large Bridge Troll by the name of Daisy, though she certainly didn’t act like a daisy. She stood before a crowd of Trollaland’s citizens and attempted to quiet the crowd. The competition had already been officially delayed.

“We need to look into this!” exclaimed the old Tree Troll called Willow. “The integrity of our competition relies on it. It is only fair that the McTrolls allow us to look under their bridge. What are they hiding?” he said, and several people around him began to applaud.

It is only fair that the McTrolls allow us to look under their bridge. What are they hiding?”</voice> he said, and several people around him began to applaud.

atoms.text: “We at the society are very sorry that you have found strange mites in your bridges, but the society does not believe in bridge briars,” explained Daisy. “It simply has nothing to do with us. Every troll has the same opportunity in Trollaland, and it appears that you have not taken very good care of your bridges. The McTrolls should not be punished for your circumstances.”

Every troll has the same opportunity in Trollaland, and it appears that you have not taken very good care of your bridges. The McTrolls should not be punished for your circumstances.”</voice>

atoms.text: Normally quite shy, Petunia the Flower Troll decided to speak up, “But that’s not right! These bridges are the life of a Bridge Troll, and they work the whole year for this competition. These briars could have come at any time, but they chose today. It’s no coincidence, and I think the McTrolls are hiding something.”

It’s no coincidence and I think the McTrolls are hiding something.”</voice> At this, everyone cheered loudly.

atoms.text:
Knut watched the people of Trollaland become increasingly agitated and wondered what would happen. He didn’t see a way out of this, and it didn’t look like the other trolls were going to forget this so easily. Then, close behind his back, he heard the sound of Troll tears. Troll tear drops grow larger as they fall, becoming snowball sized by the time they hit the ground with large splashes. An entire troll city could be potentially flooded if too many trolls were overcome with tears at once.

Knut turned to see Forsythia McTroll, the youngest of the family standing in a large puddle of her tears. “Forsythia, what’s upset you?” asked Knut. Forsythia was younger than Knut, and they didn’t know each other very well.

Forsythia was younger than Knut, and they didn’t know each other very well.

atoms.text:
“I… I… feel so terrible!” Her tears came even faster and the puddle grew. Knut was feeling very sorry for her and wanted to make her feel better if he could. “Why do you feel terrible?” he asked.
“I know why the briars came today and why they eat bridges. I’ve always known. I never wanted other people to feel bad!”

I’ve always known. I never wanted other people to feel bad!”</voice>

atoms.text: How did Forsythia know? What did she know? “Forsythia, I think you should tell everyone what you know. It’s very important. Everything will be ok, it’s the right thing to do,” he said. “I’ll help you. We can walk to the front together, and I will stand next to you the whole time.”

atoms.text:
They walked to the front where Daisy stood. The brave little troll cleared her throat, wiped her watery eyes and said, “We discovered the briars years ago. We found that they love sugar and cement. Each morning on the day of the contest, we cover the bridges with sugar, knowing that the briars will come within minutes and begin eating the bridges! We haven’t won fairly.” She once again erupted into tears and ran from the stage.

Knut was shocked. Nobody could have guessed the McTrolls had been sabotaging the contest for so long! The crowds erupted into chaos the likes of which Trollaland had never seen.

atoms.a: Select the list of qualities that best describe Daisy.
What is the opinion of Daisy and the McTrolls on the bridge briars?
b: ++Briars don’t exist and people’s bridges are falling because they don’t take enough care of them.
Briars are a dangerous threat that the Trollaland trolls should take more seriously.
Briars are innocent creatures that should be put on the endangered species list.

atoms.a: Who does Knut hear crying troll tears behind him?

b: ++She revealed that the McTroll family has been cheating the contest for years.
++She revealed that the McTrolls knew the briars were real.
She revealed that she and her family are going on holiday next week.
